title: Learning Planner packet
description: Doc 17 section 7. The eleventh agent reads the map, the missions, the paths and recent evidence, and decides what to learn next. Almost all of that is a rule rather than a judgement: the frontier and the level are computed before this packet is built, and the only thing a model is asked is how a topic nobody has a concept for decomposes. So the packet carries no passages and no card text: a lesson plan is made from what the learner has done, not from material to write from.

reason.description: Doc 17 section 7: the Planner runs on mission creation, path load, lesson end, and on demand.

topic.description: The one thing a model is asked about: a topic with no concepts on the map yet. Null on every other run, and then the Planner does no model work at all.

concepts.description: The map as it stands. Doc 17 section 2.1's learning columns, which is what the frontier rule reads.

edges.description: Prerequisite structure. Doc 17 section 2.1 keeps these apart from the links that bind a concept to content.

doctrine.description: Doc 17 section 8's learning doctrine, as the pack states it. The Planner never decides what mastery means.

max_new_concepts.description: Doc 17 section 7: "at most three new ones". A limit on the packet rather than a hope in the prompt.
